main_text.p: 17 Perfecerunt q; negotium ipsum in omnibus viris qui duxerant vxores alienigenas, vsq; ad diem primam mensis primi.
18 Et inuenti sunt de filijs Sacerdotum, qui duxerant vxores alienigenas: de filijs Iesua filij Iosadac, & fratrum eius, Maaseiah, & Eliezer, & Iarib, & Gedaliah.
19 Et dederunt manum suam vt educerent vxores suas: & qui dereliquerant, (venerunt) cum ariete pecorum pro delicto suo.
20 Et de filijs Immer, Lanani, & Zebadiah.
21 Et de filijs Harim, Maaseia, & Elijah, & Semaaiah, & Iehiel, & Vzziiah.
22 Et de filijs Pashur, Elioenai, Maaseiah, Ismael, & Nethanel, Iozabad, & Elasah.
23 Et de Leuitis, Iozabad, & Simi, & Celaiah (ipse(est) Celitah, Pethahiah, Iehudah, & Eliezer.
24 De cantoribus vero Eliasib: & de ianitoribus Sallum, & Telem, & Vri.
25 Et de Israele: de filijs Paros, Ramiah, & Iezijah, & Malchijah, & Mijamim, & Elazar, & Malchijah, & Benaiah.
26 De filijs autem Elam, Matthaniah, Zechariah, Iehiel, & Abdi, Ieremoth, & Elijah.
27 Et de filijs Zatthu, Elioenai, Eliasib, Mat thaniah, & Ieremoth, & Zabad, & Aziza.
28 De filijs praeterea Bebai, Iehohanam, Hananiah, Zabbai, & Athlai.
29 De filijs autem Bani, Mesullam, Malluch, & Adaiah, Iasub, & Seal, Ieramoth.
30 Et de filijs Pahathmoah, Adna, & Chelal, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Matthaniah, Besalel, Bimmi, & Menasseh.
31 De filijs vero Harim, Eliezer, Ishijah, Malchijah, Semaiah, Simon.

page.notes: Verse number 39 at the start of verse 30 is a printing error for 30; the marginal blot near verse 30 is a stain. Some words in the Hebrew-name transliterations are doubtful and may be misprinted.
